problem_statement: The DNS-SD discovery proxy answers DNS queries (service browse, service resolve, address resolve, and record queries) with TTL values taken directly from the underlying SRP/discovery data, which can be much larger than the maximum allowed by RFC 8766. As a result the TTL fields returned in the DNS answers for service, host-address, TXT, and generic records are not bounded. When the proxy is queried for these records, the returned TTL must be capped so it never exceeds the allowed maximum (10 seconds), regardless of the larger TTL held by the originating service data.
